findings.description: Current dependency compatibility evidence is incomplete. Six recorded dependencies have changed since the 123-test source-structure regression, including aidd_progress dependencies aidd_rules.py and aidd_evidence.py. The six round06 logs and their input hashes match current files, but those commands do not execute test_aidd_source_shape, test_aidd_progress or test_progress_resolution. They therefore do not establish this unit's integration behavior against the current dependency closure.

The descriptor check detects replacement of the file but does not detect modification of the same file during inspection. _read_source compares device/inode before reading, then returns decoded bytes without checking post-read size or modification metadata. A concurrent truncation can consequently produce an empty AST and status clean instead of unknown. This undermines inspection integrity and the documented handling of unstable inputs.
findings.evidence: Static source inspection; this scenario was not executed.
findings.recommendation: Compare descriptor metadata before and after reading and reject observed changes as unknown. Add coverage for in-place truncation and rewriting.
